title: phthirusa domingensis

It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phthirusa domingensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities.
